name: Nevada Dream Tags Charitable Fund grants
summary: Nevada grants for preserving, protecting, managing and restoring big game, other wildlife and at-risk habitat through collaborative projects, paid on a reimbursable basis. Emergency requests are accepted at any time.
reporting: Grantees provide quarterly reports on their project activities and sign a grant agreement.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must be registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit agencies, nonprofit educational institutions, or governmental entities.

geography.quote: Projects must be performed in Nevada.
